verdict.rationale: This axis applies: LangGraph's CLI runs a local Agent Server that exposes API endpoints for runs, threads and assistants, so a published machine-readable spec is a fair expectation. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the docs domain all returned 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation indexes, not API specs, so they don't count here.
